mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—where we’ll pull back the curtain on the forces quietly shaping our daily lives. Have you ever wondered why your morning coffee costs what it does, or what’s really happening behind those price tags in the supermarket? Together, we’ll explore the invisible threads that connect our choices, the prices we pay, and the opportunities we stumble upon—or sometimes miss entirely. In The Undercover Economist, Tim Harford invites us to see the world through a new lens, tracing how scarcity, incentives, and competition work their magic in the background. Think of it as an exploration of the subtle dance between supply and demand, the clever strategies behind pricing, and those hidden negotiations that steer our money and resources—often without us even noticing. As we peel back the layers of daily transactions, we’ll uncover the logic behind what might seem like random costs, and discover the real value of the things we buy and use every day. From the rush of city streets to the complexities of international trade, we’ll see how economic principles explain everything from traffic jams to global markets. Along the way, we’ll shine a light on power, privilege, and profit—and maybe even challenge a few assumptions about what’s fair or efficient. With each new perspective, the world starts to look a little less chaotic and a lot more connected. So, if you’re curious about the hidden forces shaping the choices you make and the life you lead, let’s dive in—together.
